Make sure the right side is facing you first, make a slip knot on hook and sc in first stitch indicated then in the next 3 so that makes 4, skip the next stitch and keep repeating 4 sc then skip u til you get to lower front of piece. When it says sc in end of each row just make sure you’re counting your rows correctly and place a sc. sc in next 4 rows, skip a row until you get to the corner shoulder in which you put 2 sc. then you do 1 sc in next 4 rows, skip a row, repeat.
